disciplines.name: Praestantia
disciplines.summary: Akhud combat instinct drawn from stolen Kindred experience, boosting Dexterity and attacks.

powers.name: Praestantia

cost.note: Persistent effects are free; each active effect costs 1 Vitae

powers.summary: Persistent Dexterity and Initiative bonus; spend Vitae for attack bonuses or redoing failures.

clans.name: Akhud

bane.name: The Curse of Five
bane.summary: Knowingly harming another Akhud costs dice equal to half (10 - Humanity), rounded up; at chance die it dramatically fails. Cannot be compelled.

clans.summary: A near-extinct Babylonian lost clan steeped in diablerie, bound by an oath of kinship.

clans.name: Hollow Mekhet

bane.name: The Haunted Curse
bane.summary: Replaces the Mekhet bane. Your Ka, a hungry ghost of yourself, harasses you as an ephemeral being whose Rank rises as Humanity falls (1 at Humanity 9–10, up to 5 at 1–2). It only appears in reflections, recordings and calls; you earn a Beat when it turns up more often than your Humanity allows.

clans.summary: Mekhet without shadow, reflection or echo: all of it lives on in the Ka, a jealous ghost-double that haunts them.

clans.name: Julii

bane.name: The Strigid Curse
bane.summary: Your dice pools to resist the Numina, Embodiments and Dread Powers of the Strix and other ephemeral beings can't be higher than your Humanity.

clans.summary: Warrior-emperors of the Kindred Camarilla of Rome, brought down by the Strix and all but gone.

clans.name: Pijavica

bane.name: The Mutative Curse
bane.summary: −1 to Mental and Social Attributes for each dot of Blood Potency below 4, and −1 to Physical Attributes for each dot above 7. Before an action with a reduced Attribute, roll Humanity minus the reduction; success restores it for that action.

clans.summary: Vampires grown from a mass of congealed Vitae, whose shape and mind hold together only within a narrow band of Blood Potency.

archetypes.name: Collector
archetypes.singleWillpower: Go out of your way to acquire something typical of the time and place you're in.
archetypes.allWillpower: Put adding to your collection ahead of your own safety or the Masquerade.

archetypes.name: Meddler
archetypes.singleWillpower: Get involved in someone else's business without being asked.
archetypes.allWillpower: Interfere in a precarious or dangerous situation so you can take the credit for how it turns out.

archetypes.name: Provocateur
archetypes.singleWillpower: Stir up dissent among others for no reason but to do it.
archetypes.allWillpower: Set others against each other when you know lives and futures are at stake.

elderBanes.name: The Captivating Curse
elderBanes.summary: On top of the Wanton Curse with mortals, you're no longer immune to other blood bonds once you're fully bound to one regnant.

elderBanes.name: The Visceral Curse
elderBanes.summary: Bestial, Wanton and Competitive are no longer limited to once a month: you take them every time your Beast rises close to the surface.

elderBanes.name: The Primeval Curse
elderBanes.summary: Any bane you suffer, fire and sunlight included, can be used to ward a place against you or bind you there, as if you were an ephemeral being.

elderBanes.name: The Desolate Curse
elderBanes.summary: Detachment rolls made away from all of your Touchstones take −2, on top of any other penalties.

elderBanes.name: The Apathetic Curse
elderBanes.summary: You can only regain all your Willpower through your Mask with one of your Touchstones present; with no Touchstones, your Mask restores none.

devotions.name: Annals of Death
devotions.summary: Read a place's history of deaths, Embraces and Final Deaths: one question per success, or spend them to foresee who dies there next. Once per location per scene.

devotions.name: Bones of the Mountain

cost.note: Plus 3 Vitae for each extra turn

devotions.summary: Turn your body to living stone: every active Resilience and Vigor effect for free, Protean added to Resilience, and lethal unarmed attacks.

devotions.name: Celebrity
devotions.summary: A Charmed or Enthralled fan spreads your fame, earning you a temporary dot of Allies, Fame, Herd, Retainer, Staff or Status each scene, and Majesty in their area gains 9-again.
devotions.requirement: The target must have the Charmed or Enthralled Condition from you; against Enthralled, no roll is needed.

devotions.name: Consumption
devotions.summary: Hollow out a possessed mortal's will, leaving them Enslaved: you can possess them again for 1 Vitae, without a roll, whenever they can hear your voice.
devotions.requirement: You must be possessing a mortal with Dominate; anyone with a Supernatural Tolerance trait is immune.

devotions.name: Crush of Years
devotions.summary: Everyone younger than a century within twice your Blood Potency in yards who sees you and loses the contest is Crushed by the weight of your years.

devotions.name: Legion
devotions.summary: Link to every animal of one kind within your Blood Potency in miles: +5 to Perception and search rolls, and spend Vitae to ride one animal's senses.
devotions.requirement: First drink the equivalent of 10 Vitae from a single kind of animal.

devotions.name: Malignant Smog
devotions.summary: Your Primeval Miasma becomes a poisonous gas twice as wide that moves at your Speed, inflicting a Tilt you choose on those inside who fail Stamina rolls.

devotions.name: Pass into Yesteryear
devotions.summary: Anyone your blood starts or strengthens a Vinculum in also becomes Forgotten by the people they know.

devotions.name: Preternatural Instinct
devotions.summary: Apply Defense against attacks you can't see coming, and win Clashes of Wills over who acts first after spending Vitae for Initiative.

devotions.name: Spontaneous Ignition
devotions.summary: Vibrate a touched victim until they burst into flames, at torch size and heat plus one step per success, burning for your Blood Potency in turns.
devotions.requirement: You must touch the target. Resisted by Stamina.

devotions.name: Unbridled Force
devotions.summary: Push, pull, lift, throw and punch at a distance of up to ten times your Blood Potency in yards, always at full strength.

rituals.name: Manananggal's Working
rituals.summary: Elder rite: costs twice as much to cast. Tear off parts of your body that move and act on their own until sunrise; any part lost or destroyed bursts and hurts you. All the Vitae must be your own.

rituals.name: Gwydion's Curse
rituals.summary: Elder rite: costs twice as much to cast. Vitae soaked into the earth animates trees and large plants within Potency yards to attack anyone in reach until sunrise.

rituals.name: Scapegoat
rituals.summary: Elder rite: costs twice as much to cast. Until sunrise a mortal suffers your banes and breaking points in your place; afterwards you're Wanton, with −3 to breaking points until it resolves.

rituals.name: Curse of Isolation
rituals.summary: Elder miracle: costs two Willpower to cast. Steal a vampire's Touchstone, who must be present, as your own for seven nights, or keep them by buying the Touchstone Merit.
rituals.contestedBy: Resolve + Blood Potency of the Touchstone's vampire

rituals.name: Orison of Voices
rituals.summary: Elder miracle: costs two Willpower to cast. For three nights, hear anyone anywhere who speaks your name, with enough context to know what they mean by it.

rituals.name: Sins of the Ancestors
rituals.summary: Elder miracle: costs two Willpower to cast. Ask Potency simple questions about the subject's close blood relations: sire, childer and near blood kin, or a mortal's family.
rituals.sacrament: At least 1 Vitae, or 2 lethal Health of blood from a mortal, from the subject

mysteries.name: Coil of the Quintessence
mysteries.summary: An elder Coil that makes a Dragon one with her domain. It counts as part of the Mystery of the Voivode, usually learned after its fifth dot, and needs a domain she has called home for a century.

coil.name: Coil of the Quintessence
coil.summary: Binds the Dragon to her domain, which feeds, shelters and informs her.

tiers.name: Forever Mine
tiers.summary: Sense any Kindred who feeds or kills in your domain without leave, and lash out at them with your predatory aura from any distance.

tiers.name: Home Turf
tiers.summary: People of your domain must spend Willpower to resist your attempts to feed on them.

tiers.name: Smother
tiers.summary: Fires near you count one step smaller and cooler; in your domain, +1 to resist fire and heat powers, and Vitae starts a Clash of Wills to put out supernatural fire.

tiers.name: In the Motherland's Arms
tiers.summary: Sleeping in your domain counts as Haven and Safe Place of half your Blood Potency; in a haven you own, both count one dot higher.

tiers.name: Fingers on a Dead Pulse
tiers.summary: For a Vitae, learn a local's Vice and shameful Conditions; once a scene, gain Willpower when you see one regain it from their Vice.

scales.name: Codependency
scales.summary: Bury ghouls alive across your domain and pour out all your Vitae on their graves: for a year, persuading locals to aid your Aspirations gains 9-again, and every vampire who lives there shares Fingers on a Dead Pulse.

scales.name: Cold of the Grave
scales.summary: Put out a pyre at the heart of your domain with your Vitae, other vampires' blood and the remains of its dead: for a year, every vampire who lives there gains Smother.

merits.name: Around the Block
merits.summary: You've seen and done it all: no untrained penalty on any Skill.

prerequisites.text: At least one Skill at 6 dots or more

merits.name: Beloved
merits.summary: +1 to detachment rolls on nights you spend an hour with your mortal beloved; if they die, roll detachment at once.

merits.name: Call the Beast
merits.summary: Use Animalism and its Devotions on revenants, resisted by Resolve + current Vitae.

merits.name: Civilization Stalker
merits.summary: Centuries of watching empires rise and fall: 9-again on Politics, Socialize or Streetwise when that experience applies.

merits.name: Heart of Stone
merits.summary: Your Touchstones are lasting institutions: losing them all costs only −1 on detachment, but your bonus is at most +2.

merits.name: Majordomo
merits.summary: You keep a safe meeting place for Kindred: +2 to Persuasion, Intimidation and Socialize with Kindred, but −2 if one is harmed there until you make amends.

merits.name: Married by Blood
merits.summary: You and your vampire spouse pool your Haven and Retainers, but lose shared Status together.

merits.name: Mentor in Immortality
merits.summary: One student per dot, each owing a favor once a story in return for your secrets; the Storyteller may endanger them once a story, for a Beat.

merits.name: Mother-Goddess' Altar
merits.summary: When you lead Crúac with teamwork on your Altar, the time between rolls isn't doubled, even with helpers who lack Crúac.

merits.name: Practiced Puppeteer
merits.summary: 9-again with a chosen Discipline and its Devotions against mortals or those whose Supernatural Tolerance is 4 or more below your Blood Potency.

merits.name: Prima Donna
merits.summary: Free of the covenants: once a story per dot, spend Willpower to shrug off soft leverage, end a mundane Social Condition, raise a Status, or gain 8-again socially against a covenant member.

prerequisites.text: No Covenant Status; buying any loses this Merit

merits.name: Receptive Mind
merits.summary: Lay Open the Mind reaches one extra target per dot at no extra cost.

merits.name: Savior of the Lost
merits.summary: Uplift a willing revenant without losing Humanity on a successful detachment roll, spending Willpower instead.

merits.name: Special Treat
merits.summary: A ghoul with addictive blood, which you can become addicted to; he needs 2 Vitae a month.

merits.name: Spectral Communion
merits.summary: Once a story, bind your Ka in a mirror anointed with 3 Vitae, then trap it there or let it walk with you for a while.

merits.name: Undeniable Aura
merits.summary: Your predatory aura is always out: those who resist it and lose give you an exceptional success on 3 for your first Social roll against them.

merits.name: Stare Decisis
merits.summary: Carthian Law: your opinions set legal precedent. Others spend Willpower to oppose you over accusations, and you regain Willpower when a ruling goes your way.

merits.name: Dynasty Progenitor
merits.summary: You founded your dynasty: double the blood sympathy bonus to Disciplines and Devotions used on its members.

merits.name: Oath of Dynasty
merits.summary: Bound to a small cyclical dynasty: borrow a member's Social Merit once a chapter, share thrice-removed blood sympathy, and speak with or rouse torpid members.

conditions.name: Anchored Heart
conditions.summary: You've invested yourself in a mortal and steer them, openly or from the shadows, toward the life you think they should have.
conditions.resolution: They die, or you cut them loose and roll detachment.
conditions.beat: They gain a Beat or face a breaking point through a situation you set up.

conditions.name: Beast's Bargain
conditions.summary: No frenzy penalty for hunger, but you must feed whenever it's safe to, even when you're full.
conditions.resolution: Regain a dot of Humanity, lose one, or get an exceptional success on a breaking point tied to the bargain.
conditions.beat: You feed at a moment that costs you dearly.

conditions.name: Beloved Enemy
conditions.summary: Someone you love has become your enemy. He comes at you with everything; you can hurt his interests but can't bring yourself to kill him.
conditions.resolution: He stops fighting you, or you finally kill him, which is always a breaking point.
conditions.beat: He hurts you badly and you don't strike back.

conditions.name: Children of the Blood
conditions.summary: A revenant you created follows you wherever you go, with blood sympathy of +6 to you. The Storyteller decides what she wants.
conditions.beat: She causes you psychological trauma or makes other vampires shun you.

conditions.name: Crushed
conditions.summary: The weight of centuries flattens you. You can't regain Willpower at all, and every Willpower you spend costs two.
conditions.resolution: Face a breaking point, or take lethal or aggravated damage in one of your three rightmost Health boxes.

conditions.name: Curated
conditions.summary: You and other elders share a ghoul who enforces a bargain between you, and won't bend on it. You can buy him as a Retainer.
conditions.resolution: The ghoul or your partners die, or the bargain ends.
conditions.beat: The bargain gets in the way of your own plans.

conditions.name: Forgotten
conditions.summary: Everyone you know assumes you've gone. You count as under Face in the Crowd, and those who know you see a stranger unless you spend Willpower for the scene. Your regnant, thralls and those you've Dominated or swayed with Majesty still know you.
conditions.resolution: Break your blood bond to your regnant, or lose a dot of Humanity or Integrity forcing someone to recognize you.
conditions.beat: You hurt yourself or others trying to be noticed.

conditions.name: Immutable Heart
conditions.summary: You've given yourself wholly to an institution or way of life. Your first Touchstone reflects it and gives +3 on detachment, +4 with more, but none of them can be replaced.
conditions.resolution: You lose the Touchstone and take Languid, or give it up, rolling detachment.
conditions.beat: You risk your existence to protect the Touchstone.

conditions.name: Imprisoned Echo
conditions.summary: Your Ka is trapped in a mirror. Its fury adds its Rank to rolls to escape captivity or flee danger. Left alone, it ends after your Blood Potency in nights, and the Ka's Rank is a penalty on Social rolls for a chapter.
conditions.resolution: Smash the mirror to set it free, dramatically failing a Social roll as it meddles at once.

conditions.name: Leveraged
conditions.summary: Your ghoul is perfect in every way but one: he knows you too well, senses your moods as thrice-removed blood sympathy, and knows where the bodies are buried.
conditions.beat: You go out of your way to keep him happy, in case he talks.

conditions.name: Living Legend
conditions.summary: A famous work of fiction is about you. −1 to Social rolls with Kindred who know, −2 with the Invictus, but +2 with mortals.
conditions.resolution: You separate yourself from the character, by rewriting the story or burying the evidence.

conditions.name: Lost Lineage
conditions.summary: You come from a clan or bloodline long gone. You never gain Clan Status and must pass as a modern clan or risk your Social Merits or a Blood Hunt. Choose three in-clan Disciplines and a bane with the Storyteller.
conditions.resolution: Only a rare ritual that re-Embraces you into a modern clan, with the Storyteller's permission.
conditions.beat: You suffer a real loss protecting the secret.

conditions.name: Quiet Echo
conditions.summary: Your Ka walks free beside you, in Twilight and seen only by you, doing as it pleases. It ends with no other effect at sunrise.
conditions.resolution: The Ka does you a significant favor and you regain a Willpower.

conditions.name: Synchronized
conditions.summary: You fed too deeply and became one with your victim: their damage and Conditions are yours too, though you still take damage as a vampire. Only one at a time; a new victim replaces the old.
conditions.resolution: The victim dies, you gain a dot of Humanity, or a new victim replaces this one.

conditions.name: Vitae's Resoluteness
conditions.summary: With nothing left to care for, you turned to drink. Ignore Languid in any scene you drank Vitae, but torpor is worked out as if your Humanity were 2 lower.
conditions.resolution: No resolution given; it lasts while you're Languid and Addicted to Vitae.
conditions.possibleSources: Taken with Languid while Addicted to Vitae
